present_2026_nbt_sensitivity.dispatch_basis: existing scenario traces; no NBT reoptimization

rate_provenance.inherited_cea_source: https://thecleanenergyalliance.org/solar-impact/, fetched 2026-08-01: "The energy values are based on the same export credit pricing paid by San Diego Gas & Electric (SDG&E)" + "Solar Impact customers earn an additional $0.01 per kWh for energy they export to the grid."

assumptions.import_basis: gross imports at canonical frozen R.UDC + R.CEA + R.PCIA + R.NBC; distinct service dates times R.BSC
assumptions.nbc_basis: gross imports in existing NBT proxy; separate from NEM-ST positive physical interval-net NBC
assumptions.export_eligibility: whole-account hypothetical credit channels: all physical exports for credited; remaining old-export channel for zero_credit/zero_export; no SB 868 compensation determination
assumptions.calendar_mapping: observed local timestamps unchanged; saved 2026 prices by month, rates.off_peak_day holiday/weekend and hour; quarter-hour kWh sum; repeated fall-DST rows retained; missing spring hour not invented
assumptions.credit_settlement: unrestricted signed subtraction only; separate credit pools, banks, relevant periods, floors and NSC not applied; calendar months are not established billing cycles
assumptions.credit_retention: SDG&E eligible delivery credits carry forward during NBT service; CEA terms describe annual remaining generation-credit forfeiture and separate net-surplus settlement; provider rules are not interchangeable
assumptions.diagnostic_allocation: CEA bonus grouped with generation only for diagnostics; PCIA outside delivery/generation pools pending exact eligibility research

installed_baseline.powerwall: hypothetical only; no installed home battery

assumptions.policy: simple schedule: solar surplus charge any period, grid charge only SOP; discharge only off/on-peak; no simultaneous charge/discharge per controller
assumptions.access: total-meter load access assumed; no real circuit eligibility established; all installed costs unknown
assumptions.pv: separate hypothetical DC size = 1.25 times AC cap; AC-coupled PV; no DC recovery above AC cap; hourly proxy spread evenly across meter rows
assumptions.shape: production_proxy follows existing rooftop, not measured south portable placement; delayed_2h is hypothetical west/delayed proxy, not irradiance model; shade_50pct and winter_80pct are assumed energy reductions
assumptions.interval: 15-minute gross import/export can reflect changes inside the interval. Offset-first allocation is a modeled assumption, not proof of simultaneous instantaneous flows.
assumptions.export_credit: credited grants canonical NEM to incremental meter exports. zero_credit removes credit for ALL incremental meter exports, including displaced existing rooftop exports. Existing baseline rooftop exports retain canonical credits unless a battery consumes them. Electron-origin and legal eligibility unknown.
assumptions.zero_export: perfect control curtails only new residual PV; existing rooftop exports remain. This is incremental zero-export, not whole-site zero-export; device/control feasibility unknown.
assumptions.controllers: supplied sequence shares remaining imports and both solar source accounts; no intentional battery export; new surplus charges first; both dispatch orders reported
assumptions.shared_ac: all new PV AC always uses the stated balcony cap, including PV sent to home storage. Default membership includes all controllers; explicit empty membership caps PV only; explicit indices select portable discharge only. Separately connected home storage retains individual limits in new joint rows. Existing rows retain their original cap scope.
assumptions.base_battery: 20% reserve, 85% RTE split symmetrically, 10W continuous AC standby; assumptions, not measured product behavior
assumptions.economics: 5% real discount, 1% annual savings decline, zero real tariff escalation; no replacement/subscription/maintenance cost assumed because quote unknown; ceilings before those costs
assumptions.equipment_price: $1399 per 1.92kWh unit from supplied issue snapshot, observation date 2026-10-22; equipment-only marginal illustration, not installed price or available-stock claim
assumptions.backup: constant-load conditional runtime only; known product/circuit surge limits absent; no existing Enphase outage production or solar recharge assumed
assumptions.bill_limitations: calendar-month model differs from statement windows; frozen rate vintage differs from historical bills; documented historical residual remains unexplained. NBC sums positive physical import minus physical export within each fifteen-minute interval. Actual bills support this basis; exact utility interval mapping, precision, and grouped rounding remain unresolved. Uncredited exports still enter physical NBC netting as a modeling assumption; compensation and interconnection eligibility remain separate unresolved questions. Absolute modeled bills are not actual bills.
assumptions.fixed_costs: electric daily charge unchanged; gas unchanged and excluded from electric model
assumptions.incentives: zero homeowner federal25D credit; other incentive/VPP eligibility and monetary backup value unknown

basis.rate_snapshot: June 2026 EV-TOU-5 / CEA Clean Impact Plus; canonical analysis/rates.py
basis.comparison: hardware-only after the free fix; free behavior savings excluded
basis.access: total-meter load access assumed; no real circuit eligibility established; all installed costs unknown
basis.policy: simple schedule: solar surplus charge any period, grid charge only SOP; discharge only off/on-peak; no simultaneous charge/discharge per controller
basis.pv_proxy: separate hypothetical DC size = 1.25 times AC cap; AC-coupled PV; no DC recovery above AC cap; hourly proxy spread evenly across meter rows
basis.shape: production_proxy follows existing rooftop, not measured south portable placement; delayed_2h is hypothetical west/delayed proxy, not irradiance model; shade_50pct and winter_80pct are assumed energy reductions
basis.export_credit: credited grants canonical NEM to incremental meter exports. zero_credit removes credit for ALL incremental meter exports, including displaced existing rooftop exports. Existing baseline rooftop exports retain canonical credits unless a battery consumes them. Electron-origin and legal eligibility unknown.
basis.month_scope: Retain all partial calendar months; tariff seasons use rates.SUMMER_MONTHS; no partial-month annualization.

evening_output_example.capacity_basis: Full starting battery; discharge to 20% reserve; symmetric square-root efficiency; no standby allowance.
conditions: Full 1.2kW of eligible grid import in every 15-minute interval from 16:00 to 24:00.
Full starting battery; no outage; no product certification or supported connection inference.
Grid charge uses super-off-peak import prices at 85% RTE; charge-power and charging-duration feasibility are not established.
Monthly NEM netting, rooftop generation and home storage can reduce realized marginal value.
Solar charging has forgone export value; this grid-charge example does not price solar charging.
Thirty-day values repeat the same arithmetic; no annual forecast, standby, equipment or ownership costs.
